mentions.name: AI thinking workspace
mentions.description: A workspace for thinking with AI, positioned as what Cursor did for coding but applied to rigorous thinking. It uses AI as a selectively invoked sparring partner instead of a persistent, proactive, remembers-everything assistant.
mentions.problem: The trend toward persistent, proactive, remembers-everything AI is the wrong direction for thinking; AI should instead be selectively invoked as a sparring partner.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a workspace for thinking with AI. Think what Cursor did for coding, but for rigorous thinking.

evidence.value: I'm building a workspace for thinking with AI. Think what Cursor did for coding, but for rigorous thinking.
